title: GARO: Honoo no Kokuin - HOME
justification: AniList 102098 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2015-09-16) is AniDB 10278's special S2 Itoguruma: Home (Home), aired 2015-09-16. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 20753, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10278, and the special's title matches AniList's English title (GARO: THE ANIMATION - HOME) and native 糸車 HOME. The parent has no row for S2, so it lands on TVDB 0x2 Home (2015-09-15) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 63453 S0E1 Home (TMDB dates it 2015-01-02, a TMDB date error; title and order match).
